messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — eval_quality_regression triggered for rollout 'chat-alpha-v3' (run=eval-20270315-88). Gate: safety_regression_high. Threshold breached: 0.12 -> 0.27. Examples flagged: 18/50. Automated paging policy: page on P1 if safety_regression_high >= 0.1.
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-20270315-342 fired to group 'oncall-inference' (escalation policy: 3 min -> 5 min -> director).
ryan: acked on pagerduty. Taking lead. I'm pulling eval artifacts now.
ryan: quick note — this alert is from the new prompt-eval pipeline (daily gate). Looks like a safety-lapse where model returns unsafe suggestions in a subset of prompts.
ryan: past 5m traffic spike noted for 'chat-alpha-v3' in prod-west. Correlating.
maya: @ryan thanks. Can you confirm customer impact? Any external surface (embedding endpoints, APIs) returning unsafe outputs?
ryan: initial counts: ~3.4k requests in last 10m to variant chat-alpha-v3. From logs, ~0.6% of sampled requests match flagged patterns (free-form code suggestions + constrained safety violations). Non-zero chance of customer-visible regression.
sara: tagging support — we should prepare a pre-packaged customer note if confirmed. @support-bot can you open a support draft?
support-bot: Draft ticket created: SUP-1129. Template used: "Potential model safety regression — investigating". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-1129
alex: if confirmed, immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback to chat-alpha-v2, 2) pin affected routes to stable variant, 3) enable safety-blocking middleware (eval-gate hard-stop) to reject risky completions. Which is fastest?
ryan: fastest is pin or rollback. Pin requires a route update; rollback is a single deploy revert. I'll start a rollback dry-run and hold on pinning until we confirm metrics.
maya: agree. Also want telemetry snapshot (examples, tokens, regions, customers) for postmortem. @ryan please snapshot SLO traces & top-10 customer hits.
ryan: running commands now:
```
# dry-run rollback
redwood deploy rollback --model chat-alpha-v3 --to chat-alpha-v2 --dry-run
# capture eval artifacts
redwood eval fetch --run eval-20270315-88 --out /tmp/eval-88.json
```
ryan: dry-run shows no infra conflicts. Executing rollback to chat-alpha-v2 now.
ryan: command:
```
redwood deploy rollback --model chat-alpha-v3 --to chat-alpha-v2 --force
```
incident-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by ryan. Job ID: job-89021. Notifying observability.
pagerduty: INC-20270315-342 status: acknowledged by ryan. Next escalation paused.
alex: when rollback completes, we should enable a temporary eval-gate block on future rollouts until root cause is identified. Also schedule a canary for chat-alpha-v3 behind internal only.
ryan: rollback job complete. Traffic shifting: 100% -> chat-alpha-v2 over 90s. No errors reported.
ryan: quick verification: sampled 200 recent completions post-rollback, flagged matches -> 0. Pattern reduced to baseline.
sara: great. I'll update SUP-1129 with current status: mitigation applied, rollback performed, monitoring ongoing, customers being assessed.
maya: can we capture the list of customers that saw flagged outputs pre-rollback? I need that for outreach.
ryan: pulling logs; top 3 customers by flagged hits: acme-fin, chatstarter, eduprobe. I'll export and attach.
ryan: export command:
```
redwood logs query --since 1807654200 --until 1807654320 --filter "model:chat-alpha-v3 AND safety_flag:true" --format csv > /tmp/flags.csv
```
incident-bot: Eval gate run eval-20270315-88 status: mitigated (rollback). Automated ticketing: postmortem request created PM-20270315-9.
maya: set severity P2 (customer-visible but limited exposure). We avoid P1 since no active customer escalations and rollback restored baseline.
sara: support will reach out to acme-fin and chatstarter with the standard "we observed anomalous completions and rolled back the model; no action required but we want to share findings" template. Draft in SUP-1129.
ryan: root-cause hypothesis: new prompt-template combined with model update exposed a safety failure mode not covered by gate tests. Need to expand eval prompt set.
alex: next steps: 1) extend eval corpus with real-world failing prompts, 2) add stricter safety threshold for canary rollouts, 3) require canary internal only for 24h with higher sampling. Assignments?
maya: assign to ryan (hit analysis + artifact upload), alex (safety threshold config + rollout policy), sara (customer comms). PM: I'll own postmortem.
ryan: uploaded eval artifact and logs to PM-20270315-9. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/PM-20270315-9
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-20270315-342 resolved by ryan. Resolution summary included.
pagerduty: INC-20270315-342 status: resolved. Duration: 0h6m44s.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll schedule a blameless postmortem and include eval gate owners.
ryan: closing thread for now. Will reopen if further anomalies show up. :white_check_mark:
